events.title: A Powerful Start – Industry Training Workshop 01
events.description:
Mr. Bimal Rajakaruna, Ms. Miuli Kalubowila

The Software Engineering Industrial Training Program for the iCD 109th and 110th batches began with a dynamic and meaningful first day.

We had the privilege of hosting Mr. Bimal Rajakaruna, a respected psychiatrist, and Ms. Miuli Kalubowila from Generation Alpha, who set the tone for the journey ahead with sessions that went beyond technical skills.

Focusing on career mindset, mental well-being, and adapting to the real-world tech industry, the day empowered our students with the clarity and confidence to step into their professional roles with resilience and purpose.

A truly impactful beginning to what promises to be a transformative training experience.

events.title: Gaining Real-World Perspective – Industry Training 02
events.description:
As part of our continuous effort to bridge classroom learning with industry realities, Day 02 of the Industry Training Workshop for iCD 109th and 110th Batches featured an eye-opening session by Ms. Vishmi Edirimanna, Business Analyst at Tecciance (Pvt) Ltd.

Her session offered students practical insights into real-world workflows, communication dynamics, and business expectations in modern tech environments. With her valuable industry experience, students explored how analysis, collaboration, and agility come together in the software development lifecycle.

Workshops like these empower our students not just to learn, but to think like professionals – ready for what lies beyond the classroom.

events.title: Standing Out with Confidence – Industry Training Workshop 03
events.description:
Day 03 of the Industry Training Workshop for the ICD 109th and 110th Batches featured a powerful and inspiring session led by Mr. Amithe Gamage, a renowned Executive Coach and Personal Branding Strategist.

Through his dynamic approach, students discovered the true value of personal branding, learning how to communicate their strengths, build a professional presence, and stand out in a crowded industry. It was a session that not only motivated but also equipped them with tools for long-term career growth.

Workshops like these elevate our training beyond the technical, shaping confident individuals ready to make their mark.

events.title: Real-World Tech Insights – Industry Training Workshop 04
events.description:
On Day 04 of the Industry Training Workshop for the iCD 109th and 110th Batches, students had the opportunity to engage with ZinCaT Technology, a leading name in the software industry.

The session offered a deep dive into advanced practices and real-world workflows, giving students a stronger grasp of how technology evolves and operates in professional settings. It was a valuable step toward bridging their academic knowledge with practical, industry-ready skills.

Another strong step forward in nurturing tomorrow’s tech talent.

events.title: Guiding the Future – Industry Training Workshop 05
events.description:
The final day of the Industry Training Workshop for the iCD 109th and 110th batches ended on an inspiring note.

Dr. Niroth Samarawickrama, founder of iCET and a mentor with over 20 years of industry experience, delivered an impactful session that resonated deeply with the students, encouraging them to lead with purpose and confidence.

The day also welcomed two remarkable guest speakers – Mr. Raweendra Pushpakumara, Principal of Sri Sumangala College – Panadura, and Mr. Sandun Algewatta, who shared valuable perspectives on leadership, discipline, and personal growth essential for navigating today’s professional world.

A heartfelt thank you to all the speakers who played a key role in shaping and inspiring the next generation of software engineers.

events.title: iCET x Medusa 2025 – Powering Cyber Brilliance
events.description:
As the Title Partner of Medusa 2025, iCET proudly joined hands with the University of Kelaniya’s Electronics and Computer Science Club to support one of Sri Lanka’s premier inter-university Capture The Flag (CTF) competitions.

Focused on real-time cybersecurity challenges, Medusa provided students with a chance to explore, experiment, and elevate their skills in a competitive setting – from awareness sessions to high-level final battles between the top 20 teams.

This partnership reflects our ongoing mission to back bold ideas, encourage tech-driven learning, and connect with the next wave of digital problem-solvers.

Together, we’re shaping minds to face the threats of tomorrow – with skill, strategy, and a spark for innovation.

events.title: Exploring DevOps Horizons – Seminar by Mr. Ravindu Nirmal Fernando
events.description:
We were thrilled to host an eye-opening DevOps Engineering & Career Path seminar for our students, led by Mr. Ravindu Nirmal Fernando, Senior Technical Lead – DevOps at Sysco Labs.

With a deep dive into DevOps tools, workflows, and the evolving tech ecosystem, the session offered valuable perspectives for aspiring professionals.

From automation to agile practices and the roles shaping the future of development and operations, our students gained critical insights into one of today’s most in-demand fields.

A big thank you to Mr. Ravindu for his time and knowledge and to all participants for their enthusiastic engagement!

events.title: IndustryMinds – iCD 113th Batch Showcase
events.description:
A remarkable achievement for the iCET community as the IndustryMinds event for the iCD 113th Batch concluded with excellence and innovation at its core.

Kudos to Team Matrix KZ, Stackers, Nexionix, Wizarex, Nextera, and Zyphora for their exceptional teamwork, creative thinking, and strong grasp of software engineering principles.

Your passion and dedication reflect the future of the tech industry, and we’re proud to be a part of your journey. Keep pushing boundaries and building the future!

events.title: iCET at the Earth Summit 2025
events.description:
Empowering Innovation for a Sustainable Future

We were honored to collaborate with Earth Summit 2025, organized by Planet Protectors LK, where technology and environmental responsibility came together to spark real change.

Representing iCET, Dr. Niroth Samarawickrama and Mr. Dewmal Handapangoda brought forward thought-provoking insights while SYIGEN showcased their innovative SAFE APP– a crowdsourcing platform tackling the human-elephant conflict in Sri Lanka.

Our Software Engineering trainees actively contributed to this effort, gaining real-world exposure and practical learning. Additionally, iCET introduced AGRO APP, a student-built solution aimed at transforming Sri Lanka’s agricultural landscape through technology.

We’re proud to have taken part in this meaningful initiative, reinforcing our commitment to using tech for social and environmental good.

events.title: Embracing Mindfulness for Clarity and Well-Being
events.description:
A Peaceful Pause to Refocus

Our recent mindfulness session, in collaboration with the Sathi Pasala Foundation, was a refreshing reminder of the power of presence. Students were guided through meditation practices, learning how to embrace peace, clarity, and focus in the present moment.

In today’s fast-paced world, taking a pause to reflect and calm the mind is essential for mental well-being. We are grateful to the Sati Pasala Foundation for leading us on this journey toward mindfulness and tranquility.

events.title: iCET Avurudu Celebration
events.description:
Celebrating Unity, Culture & Togetherness

On April 11th, 2025, iCET proudly hosted a vibrant and meaningful Avurudu Dayout at the scenic Laya Beach — a celebration filled with tradition, joy, unity, and heartfelt connection. Organized with the enthusiastic support of our incredible students, this event honored the rich cultural heritage of the Sinhala and Tamil New Year.

From traditional games and laughter to shared meals and dance, every moment reflected the spirit of togetherness that defines the iCET community. More than a festive gathering, it was a celebration of the powerful values that fuel our journey — unity, love, and respect.

At iCET, we believe that strong bonds create strong teams. This Avurudu season reminded us that when we stand together, we rise higher — as one family, one force.

Here’s to the memories made, the friendships strengthened, and the spirit of Avurudu that lives on in all of us.

events.title: Proud Moments from the First Evaluation Program
events.description:
We are thrilled to share the success of the very first Evaluation Program of our iCP – Higher Diploma in Computer Engineering with Applied AI. Our talented iCP students proudly showcased their passion, creativity, and significant progress in the field of Software Engineering.

This event served on 26.05.2025 as a dynamic platform for students to present their innovative projects, reflect on their learning journey, and demonstrate the real-world skills they’ve gained throughout the program. From AI-powered applications to cutting-edge software solutions, the evaluations highlighted the depth of knowledge and enthusiasm within our student community.

It was truly inspiring to witness their growth and commitment as future-ready tech professionals. Congratulations to all our students for making this a memorable and impactful milestone!

events.title: Orientation Program – iCM 118 & iCD 119 Batches
events.description:
We were delighted to welcome the newest members of our iCET family during the Orientation Program for the iCM 118 and iCD 119 batches of our Software Engineering programs on 22.06.2025.

Held at the iCET Institute, this vibrant event marked the beginning of an exciting academic journey for our incoming students. The program provided a comprehensive introduction to the institute’s values, learning environment, academic expectations, and student support services.

Students had the opportunity to engage with faculty members, connect with their peers, and gain valuable insights into what lies ahead in the world of Software Engineering. The orientation also emphasized the importance of innovation, collaboration, and continuous growth—core pillars of the iCET learning experience.

We extend a warm welcome to our new students and look forward to supporting them as they embark on their path to becoming future tech leaders.

events.title: Workshop Highlights – NEXUS 1.0: Introduction to Low-Code Platforms
events.description:
We are proud to highlight the success of NEXUS 1.0, a dynamic workshop held on 24th June 2025 at iCET, focused on the Introduction to Low-Code Platforms.

This eye-opening session, organized in collaboration with Nexova (Pvt) Ltd, offered students a comprehensive look into the power and potential of low-code development tools—equipping them with future-ready skills to accelerate innovation.

We extend our heartfelt gratitude to our keynote speaker, Mr. Sahan Weerasekera, for delivering an inspiring and insightful presentation that resonated deeply with our students.

A special thanks also goes out to our esteemed speakers, Mr. Prasad Ekanayake and Mr. Praneeth Perera, whose contributions added tremendous value and practical industry knowledge to the event.

NEXUS 1.0 was more than just a workshop—it was a step forward in bridging academic learning with real-world technology trends. Thank you to everyone who made it a resounding success!

events.title: Commencement of Software Engineering Academic Sessions at iCET
events.description:
The Institute of Computer Engineering Technology (iCET) proudly welcomed the June 2025 intake of our Software Engineering program! The inaugural academic session was conducted under the expert guidance of Dr. Niroth Samarawickrama, Mr. Frank Cronemberg, and Mr. Dulan Herath.

This marks the beginning of an exciting journey for our new students as they take their first steps toward a successful future in the tech industry. With a curriculum designed to meet global standards and mentorship from highly qualified professionals, the June 2025 batch is set to thrive in both academic and professional spheres.

We wish our new students, all the best as they embark on this transformative learning experience!

events.title: Web3 App Development – Session 02
events.description: Do you want to learn about Web3 applications? A Web3 application is a decentralized application built on a blockchain—a secure, transparent digital ledger that eliminates the need for intermediaries. Non-Fungible Tokens (NFTs) are unique digital assets stored on the blockchain that represent ownership of items such as artwork or music. Consider attending the upcoming webinar to gain further insights.
